inputs.name: PairingAccessService.constructor.store
inputs.description: The HostStorageAdapter of this host object: info reads the host record from it, poll reads the pairing record, and request saves the pairing record. The constructor stores it without checking it.

inputs.name: PairingAccessService.constructor.offers
inputs.description: The PairingOfferService whose live() returns a pairing only while it has not expired, and removes it once it has; info, poll and request all call it. The constructor stores it without checking it.

inputs.name: PairingAccessService.constructor.link
inputs.description: The HostLinkService that request uses, through toHost, to send the pairing-request frame to the host; the boolean that toHost returns is ignored. The constructor stores it without checking it.

inputs.name: PairingAccessService.info.pairingId
inputs.description: The id of the pairing offer, which is the key of the stored record pairing:<pairingId>. The host generates it as 32 lowercase hex characters and the public route checks that format before this call; the service does not check it.

inputs.name: PairingAccessService.poll.pairingId
inputs.description: The id of the pairing that the phone polls, which is the key of the stored record pairing:<pairingId>. The public route checks it as 32 lowercase hex characters before this call; the service does not check it.

inputs.name: PairingAccessService.request.pairingId
inputs.description: The id of the pairing that the phone sends a request for, which is the key of the stored record pairing:<pairingId>. The public route checks it as 32 lowercase hex characters before this call; the service does not check it.

inputs.name: PairingAccessService.request.request
inputs.description: The phone's pairing request: ephemeralKey, sealed and challenge are stored with the pairing and sent to the host as they are, unopened and unchecked by this service. PairingController checks the body first, as exactly these three base64url fields: ephemeralKey 87 characters, sealed 22 to 8192, challenge 43.

outputs.name: PairingAccessService.info
outputs.description: The host id, the pairing id, the host's public key (hostKey), the offer's state and its expiry as an ISO 8601 string. It is undefined when there is no host record or no live offer for pairingId.

outputs.name: PairingAccessService.poll
outputs.description: The state of the pairing and its expiry as an ISO 8601 string. An offer that has expired is reported once as 'expired' and its record is removed; undefined is returned when no record is stored for pairingId.

outputs.name: PairingAccessService.request
outputs.description: The state 'requested' with the offer's expiry once the request is stored, which the host receives at once or when it reconnects if it is away. Otherwise it is the RelayErrorCode that refused the request: 'not-found' when no live offer exists, or 'pairing-unavailable' when the offer is neither open nor requested, or its attempts have reached remoteLimits.pairingAttempts (5).

errors.name: RangeError
errors.description: Thrown by the iso helper when an expiresAt is not a valid time (NaN or outside JavaScript's date range), as info, poll and request build their result. Errors from the store, offer and link services are not caught here and pass through unchanged.

errors.name: RangeError
errors.description: Thrown by the iso helper when the live offer's expiresAt is not a valid time, after the host record and the offer were read.

errors.name: RangeError
